fields.summary: Board View – Mouse Wheel Over Empty Board Space Scrolls the Whole Page
fields.description:
h2. Description

*In Board View the page itself must not scroll up or down — only the cards inside a column scroll.* On production, turning the mouse wheel over the empty space below a short column moves the whole page instead, and the toolbar slides off the top of the screen.

For example,

* at a 1600 px wide window the row of tabs, *Search* and filters no longer fits since the *Technician* filter was added ([SV-11326], Done 20 Oct 2026), so *Create Work Order* drops to a second line
* that pushes the board 56 px lower, so the page (1056 px) is taller than the window (1000 px) and has room to move
* the wheel over an empty area under a short column scrolls that extra space, taking the tabs, *Search*, the filters and the view switcher out of sight
* scrolling inside a column with many cards works correctly — only that column moves

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to production and check the top bar shows *Truck Hill 1*; use a browser window about 1600 × 1000.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab, type {{ZZAUTOTEST F2 Column Scroll}} in *Search* and click *Board View*.
#* *Unassigned* holds many cards; the technician columns next to it are short or empty.
#* *Create Work Order* sits on its own line under the row of tabs and filters.
# Put the mouse over the empty area below a short column (e.g. under *Ayesha Khan*) and turn the wheel down.
#* The whole page moves up: the *All / Estimates / Work Orders / Completed* tabs, *Search*, the filters and the view switcher go off the top.

*Actual Result:*

* The whole page scrolls down by 56 px and the toolbar is hidden.

*Expected Result:*

* The page does not scroll; only the content inside a column scrolls.

h2. Screenshots

!C96953-1-before-wheel.png|width=1962,height=1084!

!C96953-2-after-wheel.png|width=1962,height=1084!

h2. Environment

* *Build:* {{v26.43.0-ffea43c}} on [production|https://app.shopview.com/workorders] · *Location:* Truck Hill 1 · *User:* Admin test account · seen on 22 Oct 2026 (17:5x and 23:11 UTC) and 23 Oct 2026 (02:51 UTC) · same steps passed on staging 19 Oct 2026, before the Technician filter was added

h2. Sources

* PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", [Confluence 845185030|https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=845185030], version 74 (22 Oct 2026, Chris Ward; read 23 Oct 2026), *S3-E1*: "Every Board View column, including Unassigned, scrolls vertically on its own when its cards exceed the available viewport, while adjacent columns and pinned headers remain visible. The page itself does not scroll vertically; only the content inside each column does."
* Same PRD, version 74, section 3 (Goals): "Today’s tabs, toolbar layout and Create Work Order button stay as they are."

h2. Test case

* [C96953|https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/96953] — Each Board column scrolls on its own and technicians are never hidden
* Test in run 498: [T3481897|https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/tests/view/3481897] ([run 498|https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/runs/view/498])
